metadata.note: Kernel and controller timings use fixed states. Solver replay records evolving unconstrained equations; cold/reused timings include checks and copies. Contact includes both isolated friction solve and full collision/contact/dynamics pipeline. Allocation counts are a separate Linux C++ new probe, excluding Eigen malloc.

solver_replay.note: Replay of actual unconstrained equations. Cold and reused solves both include checks and copies; these are not pure factorization/validation timers. Initial public solve includes adapter temporaries. Endpoint gradient/output buffers are preallocated, so endpoint adapter allocations and validation are excluded. Oracle checks, recording and serialization are excluded.
